svg.title: amp Artist Detail view for Dolly Parton
svg.desc: Artist Detail view for Dolly Parton using amp's updated design system. Top chrome has a back button and a green play-all bar with the artist name Dolly Parton in mono bold black and a play triangle at the right edge. Below is a yellow Albums section block, followed by four album rows, each with a 64 by 64 colored thumbnail, album title in sans bold, and year plus track count in muted mono. Further down is a yellow Songs section block followed by two song rows showing title in sans bold, artist and album italic subtitle, and duration at right. Bottom tab bar shows Library, Search as the navy-inverted selected tab, Queue, and Active.

g.text: Dolly Parton · 9 to 5 and Odd Jobs
